<DIV align="left"><A NAME="000"></A></DIV>

<DIV align="center" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><IMG src="c11103c1110301.gif" alt="(VALE LOGO)">
</DIV>


<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>Vale pays extraordinary dividend</B>
</DIV>


<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">Rio de Janeiro, January&nbsp;14, 2011 &#151; Vale S.A. (Vale) informs that its Board of Directors approved
today the payment of the extraordinary dividend to shareholders amounting to US$ 1&nbsp;billion (R$
1,670,100,000.00), equivalent to US$ 0.191634056 (R$ 0.320048038) per outstanding common or
preferred share (5,218,279,144).
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">Vale&#146;s Executive Board proposal for the dividend to be paid to its shareholders was publicly
disclosed on September&nbsp;23 and December&nbsp;30, 2010.
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>Form of payment</B>
</DIV>


<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">The extraordinary dividend will be made as follows:
</DIV>

<DIV style="margin-top: 10pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">
<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="4%" style="background: transparent">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left">1.</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: justify">Distribution of R$ 1,670,100,000.00 equivalent to R$ 0.320048038 per outstanding
common or preferred share, in the form of interest on capital.</DIV></TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>


<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt; margin-left: 4%">The values were obtained from the conversion of the US dollar value into Brazilian reais using
the exchange rate for the sale of US dollar (Ptax &#151; option 5 code), as informed by the Central
Bank of Brazil on January&nbsp;13, 2011, of R$ 1.6701 per US dollar, as announced on September&nbsp;23
and December&nbsp;30, 2010.
</DIV>

<DIV style="margin-top: 10pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">
<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="4%" style="background: transparent">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left">2.</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: justify">The payment will be made from January&nbsp;31, 2011 onwards. The holders of American
Depositary Receipts (ADRs) and Hong Kong Depositary Receipts (HDRs) will receive the
payment through JP Morgan, as the depositary agent, on February 7 and 9, 2011,
respectively. A withholding income tax will be levied on the amount distributed as
interest on capital, in accordance with prevailing tax code in Brazil.</DIV></TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>

<DIV style="margin-top: 10pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">
<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="4%" style="background: transparent">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left">3.</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: justify">The record date for the owners of shares traded on the BM&#038;F Bovespa is January&nbsp;14,
2011. The record date for the holders of ADRs traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE)
and Euronext Paris is January&nbsp;19, 2011 and for the holders of HDRs traded on the Hong Kong
Stock Exchange (HKEx) is at the close of business in Hong Kong on January&nbsp;19, 2011. All
shareholders on these respective record dates will have the right to the dividend payment.</DIV></TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>

<DIV style="margin-top: 10pt">
<TABLE width="100%" border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt">
<TR valign="top" style="font-size: 10pt; color: #000000; background: transparent">
    <TD width="4%" style="background: transparent">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD width="3%" nowrap align="left">4.</TD>
    <TD width="1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD><DIV style="text-align: justify">Vale shares will start trading ex-dividend on NYSE and Euronext Paris as of January
14, 2011, on BM&#038;F Bovespa as of January&nbsp;17, 2011, and on HKEx as of January&nbsp;18, 2011.</DIV></TD>
</TR>

</TABLE>
</DIV>

<DIV align="right" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>For further information, please contact:</B><BR>
&#043;55-21-3814-4540<BR>

Samantha Pons: samantha.pons@vale.com<BR>
Thomaz Freire: thomaz.freire@vale.com
</DIV>


<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">This press release may contain statements that express management&#146;s expectations about future
events or results rather than historical facts. These forward-looking statements involve risks and
uncertainties that could cause actual results to differ materially from those projected in
forward-looking statements, and Vale cannot give assurance that such statements will prove correct.
These risks and uncertainties include factors: relating to the Brazilian and Canadian economy and
securities markets, which exhibit volatility and can be adversely affected by developments in other
countries; relating to the iron ore and nickel business and its dependence on the global steel
industry, which is cyclical in nature; and relating to the highly competitive industries in which
Vale operates. For additional information on factors that could cause Vale&#146;s
actual results to differ from expectations reflected in forward-looking statements, please see
Vale&#146;s reports filed with the Brazilian Comiss&#227;o de Valores Mobili&#225;rios and the U.S. Securities and
Exchange Commission.
</DIV>
